# Psalm 103 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** By David. Let everything in me praise the LORD! With all my heart, I praise his holy name!

**2** Let everything in me praise the LORD — and never forget all the good things he does:

**3** He forgives every sin. He heals every disease.

**4** He rescues your life from the grave. He crowns you with love and compassion.

**5** He fills your life with good things so that you feel young and strong again, like an eagle.

**6** The LORD brings justice and fairness to everyone who is oppressed.

**7** He revealed his character to Moses; he showed the people of Israel what he could do.

**8** The LORD is compassionate and gracious — slow to get angry and overflowing with faithful love.

**9** He won't keep accusing us forever; he doesn't hold onto his anger.

**10** He doesn't treat us the way our sins deserve; he doesn't pay us back for what we've done wrong.

**11** As high as the sky is above the earth — that's how vast his faithful love is for those who honor him.

**12** As far as the east is from the west — that's how far he has removed our sins from us.

**13** The way a father is tender with his children — that's how the LORD is tender with those who honor him.

**14** He knows what we're made of; he remembers that we're just dust.

**15** Our lives are like grass — we bloom like a wildflower in a field;

**16** the wind blows over it and it's gone, as if it were never there.

**17** But the LORD's faithful love lasts from eternity to eternity for those who honor him, and his righteousness extends to their grandchildren —

**18** to those who keep his covenant and remember to follow his instructions.

**19** The LORD has set his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules over absolutely everything.

**20** Praise the LORD, you angels of his — you powerful beings who carry out his commands and obey every word he speaks!

**21** Praise the LORD, all you armies of heaven — you servants who do whatever he wants!

**22** Praise the LORD, everything he has made — everywhere in his kingdom! And let my soul praise the LORD!

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **103:10-12**: These might be the three most comforting verses in the entire Bible. He doesn't treat us as our sins deserve. He removes them as far as east is from west — which is an infinite distance. That's not just forgiveness; it's complete erasure.

- **103:14**: 'He remembers that we are dust.' This changes everything. God isn't disappointed that we're weak — he already knows. His expectations are calibrated to our reality, and his compassion flows from that knowledge.

— PNEUMA
